articles.title: Whoa! Dinosaur Bones Still Have Real Dino Stuff Inside!
articles.summary: Scientists found real dinosaur protein in a 66-million-year-old bone. They used super-powerful tools to prove it's not just dirt or germs. This could help us learn how dinos lived and grew.

articles.title: Perseverance Rover Snaps a Stunning Mars Selfie with a View!
articles.summary: NASA's Perseverance rover took a new selfie on Mars, showing it perched on a rocky ledge. The view includes ancient cliffs and maybe a volcanic crack. It's studying some of the oldest rocks ever seen on Mars.

articles.title: Surprise! Japanese People Come from Three Ancient Groups, Not Two
articles.summary: A huge DNA study of over 3,200 Japanese people found a third ancestral group linked to northeast Asia. It also showed Japan is more genetically diverse than thought, with big differences by region.
